songs.title: God Rest Ye Merry, Gentlemen
songs.body:
[Verse]
God [Em]rest ye merry, gentlemen, let [C]nothing you dis[B7]may
Re[Em]member Christ our Savior was [C]born on Christmas [B7]Day
To [Am]save us all from [G]Satan's power when [C]we were gone a[B7]stray
O [G]tidings of [C]comfort and [G]joy, comfort and [B7]joy
O [Em]tidings of [B7]comfort and [Em]joy

songs.title: What Child Is This?
songs.body:
[Verse]
What [Am]child is this, who, [G]laid to rest
On [C]Mary's lap is [E]sleeping?
Whom [Am]angels greet with [G]anthems sweet
While [C]shepherds [E]watch are [Am]keeping?

[Chorus]
This, [C]this is [G]Christ the King
Whom [C]shepherds [G]guard and [Am]angels [E]sing
Haste, [C]haste to [G]bring Him laud
The [C]Babe, the [E]son of [Am]Mary

songs.title: Away in a Manger
songs.body:
[Verse]
A[G]way in a manger, no [C]crib for a [G]bed
The [D]little Lord Jesus laid [C]down His sweet [G]head
The [G]stars in the sky looked [C]down where He [G]lay
The [D]little Lord Jesus a[C]sleep on the [G]hay

[Verse]
The [G]cattle are lowing, the [C]Baby a[G]wakes
But [D]little Lord Jesus, no [C]crying He [G]makes
I [G]love Thee, Lord Jesus, look [C]down from the [G]sky
And [D]stay by my cradle till [C]morning is [G]nigh

songs.title: The Twelve Days of Christmas
songs.body:
[Verse]
On the [G]first day of Christmas my [D]true love gave to [G]me
A [C]partridge [D]in a pear [G]tree

[Verse]
On the [G]second day of Christmas my [D]true love gave to [G]me
[D]Two turtledoves
And a [C]partridge [D]in a pear [G]tree

songs.title: Blow the Man Down
songs.body:
[Verse]
Oh, [C]blow the man down, bullies, blow the man down
[G]Way aye, blow the man [C]down
Oh, [C]blow the man down, bullies, blow him away
Give me some [G]time to blow the man [C]down

[Verse]
As I was a-walking down Paradise Street
[G]Way aye, blow the man [C]down
A pretty young damsel I chanced for to meet
Give me some [G]time to blow the man [C]down

songs.title: Leave Her, Johnny
songs.body:
[Verse]
Oh, [G]times are hard and the [C]wages [G]low
Leave her, Johnny, [D]leave her
And [G]now ashore we [C]must [G]go
And it's [C]time for us to [D]leave [G]her

[Chorus]
Leave her, [G]Johnny, leave her
Oh, [C]leave her, Johnny, [G]leave her
For the voyage is done and the [C]winds don't [G]blow
And it's [C]time for us to [D]leave [G]her

songs.title: Spanish Ladies
songs.body:
[Verse]
Fare[Am]well and adieu to you Spanish ladies
Fare[G]well and adieu to you ladies of [Am]Spain
For we've received orders for to [G]sail for old [Am]England
And [F]hope very [G]shortly to [E]see you a[Am]gain

[Chorus]
We'll [Am]rant and we'll roar like true British sailors
We'll [G]rant and we'll roar all on the salt [Am]seas
Until we strike soundings in the [G]channel of old [Am]England
From [F]Ushant to [G]Scilly is [E]thirty-five [Am]leagues

songs.title: Haul Away, Joe
songs.body:
[Verse]
When [G]I was a little lad and so my mother told me
Way, [C]haul away, we'll [D]haul away, [G]Joe
That [G]if I did not kiss the girls my lips would grow all moldy
Way, [C]haul away, we'll [D]haul away, [G]Joe

[Chorus]
Way, [C]haul away, we'll [D]haul for better [G]weather
Way, [C]haul away, we'll [D]haul away, [G]Joe

songs.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
songs.body:
[Verse]
Oh, the [D]summer time is coming
And the [G]trees are sweetly [D]blooming
And the [G]wild mountain [D]thyme
Grows a[Em]round the blooming [G]heather

[Chorus]
Will ye [D]go, lassie, [G]go?
And we'll [D]all go to[G]gether
To pull [D]wild mountain [G]thyme
All a[Em]round the blooming [G]heather
Will ye [D]go, lassie, [G]go?

songs.title: A Red, Red Rose
songs.body:
[Verse]
O my [G]Luve is like a red, red [C]rose
That's [G]newly sprung in [D]June
O my [G]Luve is like the [C]melodie
That's [G]sweetly [D]play'd in [G]tune

[Verse]
As [G]fair art thou, my bonnie [C]lass
So [G]deep in luve am [D]I
And [G]I will luve thee [C]still, my dear
Till [G]a' the [D]seas gang [G]dry

songs.title: Annie Laurie
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Maxwellton braes are bonnie
Where [G]early [A]fa's the [D]dew
And it's there that Annie Laurie
Gave [G]me her [A]promise [D]true
Gave [G]me her promise [D]true
Which [Em]ne'er forgot will [A]be
And for [D]bonnie Annie [G]Laurie
I'd [D]lay me [A]doun and [D]dee

songs.title: Comin' Thro' the Rye
songs.source: Robert Burns, from older song (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Gin a body meet a body
[C]Comin' thro' the [G]rye
[G]Gin a body kiss a body
[A]Need a body [D]cry?

[Chorus]
[G]Ilka body has a body
[C]Ne'er a ane hae [G]I
But [G]a' the lads they lo'e me
And [D]what the waur am [G]I

songs.title: The Ash Grove
songs.body:
[Verse]
The [G]ash grove, how graceful, how [C]plainly 'tis [G]speaking
The [C]harp through it [G]playing has [D]language for me
When[G]ever the light through its [C]branches is [G]breaking
A [C]host of kind [G]faces is [D]gazing on [G]me
The friends of my childhood a[C]gain are before [G]me
Each [C]step wakes a [G]memory as [D]freely I roam
With [G]soft whispers laden its [C]leaves rustle o'er [G]me
The [C]ash grove, the [G]ash grove that [D]sheltered my [G]home

songs.title: All Through the Night
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Sleep, my child, and [C]peace attend thee
[D]All through the [G]night
[G]Guardian angels [C]God will send thee
[D]All through the [G]night
[C]Soft the drowsy hours are creeping
[G]Hill and vale in slumber [D]steeping
[G]I my loving [C]vigil keeping
[D]All through the [G]night

songs.title: Sakura
songs.body:
[Verse]
[Am]Sakura, sakura
[E]Noyama mo sato mo
[Am]Miwatasu kagiri
[E]Kasumi ka kumo ka
[Am]Asahi ni niou
[E]Sakura, sakura
[Am]Hanazakari

songs.title: Cielito Lindo
songs.body:
[Verse]
De la [G]Sierra Morena
[C]Cielito [G]lindo, vienen bajando
Un [D]par de ojitos negros
[G]Cielito lindo, [D]de contra[G]bando

[Chorus]
Ay, ay, ay, [C]ay
Canta y no [G]llore
Porque cantando se [D]alegran
Cielito lindo, los cora[G]zones

songs.title: Beautiful Dreamer
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Beautiful dreamer, [A7]wake unto me
[A7]Starlight and dewdrops are [D]waiting for thee
[D]Sounds of the rude world [A7]heard in the day
[A7]Lulled by the moonlight have [D]all passed away

[Verse]
[G]Beautiful dreamer, [D]queen of my song
[A7]List while I woo thee with [D]soft melody
[D]Gone are the cares of [G]life's busy throng
[D]Beautiful dreamer, a[A7]wake unto [D]me

songs.title: Jeanie with the Light Brown Hair
songs.body:
[Verse]
I [F]dream of Jeanie with the [C]light brown hair
Borne like a [C7]vapor on the [F]summer air
I [F]see her tripping where the [C]bright streams play
Happy as the [C7]daisies that dance on her [F]way

[Verse]
Many were the wild notes her [Bb]merry voice would [F]pour
Many were the [C]blithe birds that [F]warble[C]d them [F]o'er
I [F]dream of Jeanie with the [C]light brown hair
Floating like a [C7]vapor on the [F]soft summer air
